title: adr template variables
description: Values for templates/adr.md.j2 and templates/adr.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from adr.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

adr_number.title: Adr number
adr_number.description: Sequence number for this ADR, zero-padded to three digits. Next free number in the decision log; a reused number silently overwrites the reasoning somebody is relying on.

cost_ceiling.title: Cost ceiling
cost_ceiling.description: Monthly API spend above which this decision is re-opened, with currency. Set it now - a ceiling chosen after the invoice arrives is not a trigger, it is a reaction.

dataset_size.title: Dataset size
dataset_size.description: How many labelled examples the eval ran on. Below a couple of hundred the gap between approaches sits inside the error bar and you are choosing on noise you can reproduce.

eval_metric.title: Eval metric
eval_metric.description: The metric and the threshold that decided it - "exact-match F1 at or above 0.82". Agree the threshold before the runs, or whatever number appears becomes the threshold.

problem_statement.title: Problem statement
problem_statement.description: What has to be solved, stated without naming a technique. If the sentence already contains "RAG" or "fine-tune" you have written the answer and are now shopping for evidence.

scheduled_review.title: Scheduled review
scheduled_review.description: The scheduled review used under 'Re-evaluation Trigger'.

selected_approach.title: Selected approach
selected_approach.description: Which approach won. That order is also the order of increasing cost to change your mind - skipping a rung needs a measured reason, not an intuition about capability.

y.title: Y
y.description: Selected approach score. From section 'Evaluation Results'.
